fishing.examplemod.species.abyssal_levia: Something vast moves beneath the deep ocean. Its eyes burn red in the dark.
The deepest oceans at night. It follows the light.
fishing.examplemod.species.ancient_koi.d: Said to have swum in the cherry ponds since before the first village was built.
fishing.examplemod.species.ancient_koi.h: Cherry grove ponds, in the rain. Only gold tempts it.
fishing.examplemod.species.anglerfish.de: Its glowing lure draws prey into the dark, and it answers to a light of its own.
fishing.examplemod.species.anglerfish.hi: Deep oceans, at night. Light attracts it.
fishing.examplemod.species.arapaima.desc: One of the largest freshwater fish. It surfaces to breathe with a loud gulp.
fishing.examplemod.species.arctic_char.d: Its belly turns fiery orange in the coldest waters. Hardy and hard-fighting.
fishing.examplemod.species.blind_cavefis: Pale and eyeless, it finds food in total darkness by feeling the water move.
A torpedo of pure muscle that fights for every meter of line.
fishing.examplemod.species.bluegill.desc: A round sunfish with an orange belly. It snaps up insects that fall onto calm water.
fishing.examplemod.species.bog_lurker.de: Glowing eyes between the mangrove roots at night. Few who see them ever land one.
fishing.examplemod.species.bowfin.descri: A living fossil that can gulp air, at home in swamps where nothing else survives.
fishing.examplemod.species.carp.descript: A heavy, whiskered bottom feeder. Patient anglers tempt the big ones with dough.
fishing.examplemod.species.carp.hint: Lurks in ponds and swamps. Try dough.
fishing.examplemod.species.catfish.descr: A whiskered giant of muddy water. It hunts by smell, so strong bait works best.
fishing.examplemod.species.catfish.hint: Muddy swamps and rivers. Smelly bait helps.
fishing.examplemod.species.clownfish.des: Bright orange with white bands, it rarely strays far from its warm reef.
fishing.examplemod.species.cod.descripti: The staple catch of every coastline. Reliable, plentiful and tasty.
fishing.examplemod.species.cod.hint: Common along coasts and in temperate seas.
fishing.examplemod.species.coelacanth.de: Thought extinct for ages. Its lobed fins look almost like legs.
fishing.examplemod.species.coelacanth.hi: A living fossil of the deep oceans.
fishing.examplemod.species.frostjaw.desc: A blue-scaled predator with teeth like icicles. It hunts beneath the ice.
fishing.examplemod.species.frostjaw.hint: Hunts beneath the ice. Bring fish bait.
fishing.examplemod.species.glacial_behem: Ice clings to its scales. Sailors swear it once dragged an iceberg out to sea.
Frozen seas, under the night sky.
fishing.examplemod.species.halibut.descr: A huge flatfish with both eyes on one side. It lies hidden on the seabed.
fishing.examplemod.species.halibut.hint: The seabed of open and cold seas.
fishing.examplemod.species.icefish.descr: Its clear blood keeps it alive in water too cold for any other fish.
fishing.examplemod.species.lumen_eel.des: Rows of soft green lights run down its body, lighting up dark cave pools.
fishing.examplemod.species.mackerel.desc: A fast, striped schooling fish of the open sea. Shiny lures drive it wild.
fishing.examplemod.species.mackerel.hint: Schools in open oceans and along coasts.
fishing.examplemod.species.mahi_mahi.des: Electric green and gold. It fades to silver soon after leaving the water.
fishing.examplemod.species.minnow.descri: A tiny, darting fish found in nearly every stream and pond. Many anglers' very first catch.
fishing.examplemod.species.minnow.hint: Common in rivers and ponds. Bites almost anything.
fishing.examplemod.species.mudskipper.de: A goggle-eyed fish that spends half its life crawling across swamp mud.
Gold and green with a false eye on its tail. It strikes lures like a thunderbolt.
fishing.examplemod.species.perch.descrip: Striped and orange-finned, perch gather in cool lakes and slow rivers.
fishing.examplemod.species.perch.hint: Schools in lakes and slow rivers.
fishing.examplemod.species.pike.descript: An ambush hunter with a mouth full of needles. It strikes fish-shaped lures hard.
fishing.examplemod.species.pike.hint: Hunts rivers and lakes. Use fish or lures.
fishing.examplemod.species.piranha.descr: Small, fearless and full of teeth. A school can strip a hook of cut bait in seconds.
fishing.examplemod.species.piranha.hint: Jungle waters hide something hungry. Bring cut bait.
fishing.examplemod.species.pufferfish.de: It puffs up when threatened. Don't eat it raw.
fishing.examplemod.species.rainbow_trout: A shimmering pink stripe runs down its side. It rises to insects on clear rivers.
fishing.examplemod.species.river_monarch: A crowned fish of gold and violet that rises at dusk to rule the river.
Rivers at dusk. A golden offering helps.
fishing.examplemod.species.salmon.descri: Born in rivers, grown in the sea. A strong swimmer that fights its way upstream.
fishing.examplemod.species.salmon.hint: Runs up rivers and cold waters.
fishing.examplemod.species.sea_bass.desc: A silver-gray prowler of rocky coasts and a favorite of every seaside cook.
fishing.examplemod.species.sporefin.desc: It feeds on drifting spores and grows the same red cap as the island it lives beside.
fishing.examplemod.species.stormcaller_m: Lightning-striped and furious, it only hunts when storms tear up the sea.
The open sea, in a thunderstorm.
fishing.examplemod.species.sturgeon.desc: Armored and ancient, it can outlive a villager's grandparents.
fishing.examplemod.species.sturgeon.hint: The oldest fish in the river. It feeds along the bottom.
fishing.examplemod.species.swordfish.des: It slashes through schools with its long bill. A true test of any tackle.
fishing.examplemod.species.tropical_fish: Every color of the reef. No two are quite the same.
fishing.examplemod.tackle.attach_hint: Right-click onto a fishing rod to attach
